test_graph_equality: test two gtn Graph objects for equality using gtn.equal comparing nodes, arcs, labels, and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test two gtn Graph objects for structural isomorphism using gtn.isomorphic ignoring node ordering
test_loadtxt_graph: test loading a gtn Graph from a text file using gtn.loadtxt and verify equality with the original
test_savetxt_graph: test saving a gtn Graph to a text file using gtn.savetxt and verify the output format
test_save_load_graph: test saving and loading a gtn Graph using gtn.save and gtn.load and verify round-trip equality
